content: Hi, I'm interested in your premium brokerage plan and want pricing to sign up. My number is 9876501234, email kavya@example.com.
Thanks Kavya — I can share the fee schedule and onboarding steps.
I'm frustrated and thinking of leaving. Reduce my brokerage or I'll shift to another broker.
Sorry to hear that — can we fix this for you today?
If support stays this slow I want to close my account and transfer my holdings out.
Existing customer here — can you enable F&O and activate margin trading facility? Also add a family account.
Sure — sharing F&O activation and family account steps.
The app keeps crashing and I didn't receive OTP to login. Please reset my password.
I've triggered a password reset and a fresh OTP.

Welcome! I'll walk you through wallet setup, KYC, and card eligibility.

I'm sorry — escalating your refund and reviewing what we can offer.
I already use your wallet — can I upgrade to premium plus and increase my credit limit? Also add an add-on card.
Sure — sharing Premium Plus benefits and add-on card steps.
My UPI payment shows transaction pending — has the refund already been processed?
Yes, the refund has been processed; it will reflect in 24-48 hours.
